section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) investigating how exposure to non-body focused versus body focused others affects young women's eating and body image. The study involved 92 female college students who completed nightly online questionnaires over seven consecutive days. The findings indicate that exposure to non-body focused others predicted greater intuitive eating, body appreciation, and less dietary restraint, while exposure to body focused others predicted opposite outcomes.
